title: Human Capital Expenditure and Its Effectiveness on Multi-Program Coverage: A Policy Prioritization Investigation
title_zh: 人力资本支出对多项目覆盖率的有效性：一项政策优先级调查
authors: Guerrero, Omar A., Guariso, Daniele, Castañeda, Gonzalo, Weber, Michael
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses artificial intelligence-enhanced agent computing to determine how to allocate budgetary resources within a large set of heterogeneous government programs targeting human capital. The approach considers essential features of the budget allocation process: multidimensionality, interdependencies between policy issues, and the political economy of public officials' collective action. The analysis uses highly disaggregated Mexican data covering the 2016-2022 period across 49 federal government human capital programs. It focuses on how expenditure affects program coverage, defined as the share of the population with a public problem and that has access to various government benefits to mitigate those problems, in the short run. The paper answers three research questions. First, how sensitive is program coverage to changes in public expenditure? Second, what are the structural bottlenecks behind poor coverage response? Third, what are the optimal budgetary allocations that could boost the performance of a multidimensional objective function?
abstract_zh: 本文运用人工智能增强型智能体计算方法，探讨如何在针对人力资本的大量异质性政府项目中分配预算资源。该方法考虑了预算分配过程的核心特征：多维性、政策议题间的相互依存性，以及公共官员集体行动的政治经济学因素。分析采用2016-2022年期间墨西哥49个联邦政府人力资本项目的高度细化数据，重点研究支出如何影响项目覆盖率——即存在公共问题且能获得各类政府福利以缓解问题的人口比例——的短期效应。本文回答三个研究问题：第一，项目覆盖率对公共支出变化的敏感度如何？第二，导致覆盖率响应不足的结构性瓶颈是什么？第三，能够提升多维目标函数绩效的最优预算分配方案是什么？

title: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
title_zh: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺
authors: Robert J Barro, V V Chari
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Chamley and Judd argued that optimal taxation dictates zero long-run taxes on capital income, but Straub and Werning found that these taxes may be positive in the steady state. These models feature a ‘period-zero problem’ because the Ramsey formulation omits past commitments but includes future ones. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles (2020) add commitments to the representative household’s wealth in utility units. Then a nonzero capital levy may apply in period 1, future tax rates on asset income equal zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. Time-consistency fails if future policymakers are unconstrained but holds if wealth commitments in each period are strict enough to motivate each policymaker to choose zero capital levies. Then a timeless perspective applies where period 1 is not special, tax rates on asset income are always zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. In the neoclassical growth model with utility depending on the log of consumption, the level of the wealth commitment is constant in the steady state. Extensions allow for uncertainty and heterogeneity and for a form of partial commitment.
abstract_zh: Chamley与Judd认为最优税收理论要求资本收入长期税率为零，但Straub与Werning发现稳态下此类税收可能为正。这些模型存在"第零期问题"，因为拉姆齐框架忽略了历史承诺却包含未来承诺。Chari、Nicolini与Teles（2020）将代表性家庭以效用单位衡量的财富承诺纳入模型。此时第一期可能征收非零资本税，后续各期资产收入税率均为零，消费税率保持恒定。若未来政策制定者不受约束则时间一致性失效，但若每期财富承诺严格到足以激励每位政策制定者选择零资本税，则时间一致性成立。此时适用无时间视角：第一期不再特殊，资产收入税率始终为零，消费税率保持恒定。在消费对数效用的新古典增长模型中，稳态财富承诺水平保持恒定。该框架可扩展至包含不确定性、异质性及部分承诺形式。

title: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
title_zh: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应
authors: Gerald Van Tassell, Alan P. Ker
abstract: The United States spends billions annually on crop insurance premium subsidies, yet the prevailing distance‐based guarantee design unintentionally rewards risk‐taking by linking subsidies to yield variability. We consider a simple redesign: define guarantees in terms of probability so that coverage reflects a consistent likelihood of indemnity. Using US data, this probability‐based approach would reallocate about $3.3 billion in annual subsidies from high‐risk to low‐risk production, reducing regional disparities by two‐thirds without changing total subsidies. Because most publicly subsidized crop insurance programs around the world share this structure, adopting probability‐based guarantees could help realign agricultural production toward more resilient and sustainable regions and practices.
abstract_zh: 美国每年在农作物保险保费补贴上投入数十亿美元，然而现行基于距离的保障设计因将补贴与产量波动挂钩，无意中激励了风险承担行为。我们提出一种简单的重新设计方案：以概率定义保障，使保险覆盖范围反映一致的赔付可能性。基于美国数据的测算表明，这种概率导向方法每年可将约33亿美元补贴从高风险生产重新分配至低风险生产，在不改变补贴总额的情况下将区域差异减少三分之二。由于全球大多数公共补贴农作物保险计划均采用类似结构，采纳概率型保障有助于引导农业生产向更具韧性和可持续性的区域及实践模式转型。

title: Word2Prices: Embedding Central Bank Communications for Inflation Prediction
title_zh: Word2Prices：嵌入央行沟通文本以预测通胀
authors: Douglas Araujo, Nikola Bokan, Fabio Comazzi, Michele Lenza
official: 官方在线 2024-12-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Word embeddings are vectors of real numbers associated with words, designed to capture semantic and syntactic similarity between the words in a corpus of text. We estimate the word embeddings of the European Central Bank's introductory statements at monetary policy press conferences by using a simple natural language processing model (Word2Vec), only based on the information and model parameters available as of each press conference. We show that a measure based on such embeddings contributes to improve core inflation forecasts multiple quarters ahead. Other common textual analysis techniques, such as dictionary-based metrics or sentiment metrics do not obtain the same results. The information contained in the embeddings remains valuable for out-of-sample forecasting even after controlling for the central bank inflation forecasts, which are an important input for the introductory statements.
abstract_zh: 词嵌入是与词语相关联的实数向量，旨在捕捉文本语料库中词语之间的语义和句法相似性。我们仅基于每次新闻发布会当时可用的信息和模型参数，通过使用简单的自然语言处理模型（Word2Vec），对欧洲央行货币政策新闻发布会开场陈述进行词嵌入估计。研究表明，基于此类词嵌入的指标有助于改善未来多个季度的核心通胀预测。其他常见的文本分析技术，如基于词典的指标或情绪指标，并未获得相同结果。即使在控制了央行通胀预测（这是开场陈述的重要输入信息）之后，词嵌入中包含的信息对于样本外预测仍具有重要价值。
